                migrated_count,
                user.id,
            )

        # Clean up session
        try:
            del request.session["saved_region_events"]
        except KeyError:
            pass

    trip = _materialize_preauth_trip_draft(
        request=request,
        user=user,
        discovery_region=discovery_region,
        saved_event_ids=saved_event_ids,
        trip_model=Trip,
        trip_region_model=TripRegion,
        saved_region_event_model=SavedRegionEvent,
        trip_service=TripService,
    )
    if trip is not None:
        logger.info(
            "Materialized preauth trip %s for user %s",
            trip.id,
            user.id,
        )

    # Clean up discovery region from session
    if region_id:
        try:
            del request.session["discovery_region_id"]
        except KeyError:
            pass

    # Link anonymous conversion tracking events to user
    session_key = request.session.session_key
    if session_key:
        ConversionService.link_session_to_user(session_key, user)

    # Track signup completion
    ConversionService.track(
        request,
        stage="SIGNUP_COMPLETE",
        region=discovery_region,
        user=user,
        metadata={
            "saved_events_count": len(saved_event_ids),
            "source": "regional_calendar" if region_id else "direct",
        },
    )


def _parse_preauth_trip_date(value: object) -> date | None:
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
        return None
    try:
        return date.fromisoformat(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _get_preauth_trip_family(user: User):
    primary_family = getattr(getattr(user, "profile", None), "primary_family", None)
    if primary_family is not None:
        return primary_family
    membership = (
        FamilyMembership.objects.filter(user=user, is_active=True)
        .select_related("family")
        .first()
    )
    return membership.family if membership is not None else None


def _materialize_preauth_trip_draft(
    *,
    request: HttpRequest,
    user: User,
    discovery_region,
    saved_event_ids: list[int],
    trip_model,
    trip_region_model,
    saved_region_event_model,
    trip_service,
):
    draft = request.session.get(PREAUTH_TRIP_DRAFT_SESSION_KEY)
    if not isinstance(draft, dict):
        return None

    existing_trip_id = request.session.get(PREAUTH_TRIP_MATERIALIZED_SESSION_KEY)
    if existing_trip_id:
        try:
            return trip_model.objects.get(id=existing_trip_id, creator=user)
        except trip_model.DoesNotExist:
            pass

    family = _get_preauth_trip_family(user)
    if family is None:
        logger.warning(
            "Cannot materialize preauth trip for user %s without a family",
            user.id,
        )
        return None

    region = discovery_region
    draft_region_id = draft.get("region_id")
    if draft_region_id:
        region = trip_region_model.objects.filter(id=draft_region_id).first() or region

    date_status = draft.get("date_status")
    if date_status not in {
        trip_model.DateStatus.UNKNOWN,
        trip_model.DateStatus.EXACT,
    }:
        date_status = trip_model.DateStatus.EXACT

    if date_status == trip_model.DateStatus.UNKNOWN:
        start_date = None
        end_date = None
    else:
        start_date = _parse_preauth_trip_date(draft.get("start_date"))
        end_date = _parse_preauth_trip_date(draft.get("end_date"))
        if start_date is None or end_date is None:
            logger.warning(
                "Cannot materialize exact-date preauth trip for user %s without dates",
                user.id,
            )
            return None

    trip = trip_service.create_trip(
        name=str(draft.get("name") or f"{region.name if region else 'Family'} Trip"),
        date_status=date_status,
        start_date=start_date,
        end_date=end_date,
        location=str(draft.get("location") or (region.name if region else "")),
        description=str(draft.get("description") or ""),
        creator=user,
        family_groups=[family],
        gamification_enabled=True,
        region=region,
    )

    if saved_event_ids:
        saved_region_event_model.objects.filter(
            user=user,
            region_event_id__in=saved_event_ids,
            added_to_trip__isnull=True,
        ).update(added_to_trip=trip)

    request.session[PREAUTH_TRIP_MATERIALIZED_SESSION_KEY] = str(trip.id)
    try:
        del request.session[PREAUTH_TRIP_DRAFT_SESSION_KEY]
    except KeyError:
        pass
    return trip


def create_family_for_user(
    user: User,
    request: HttpRequest | None = None,
    role: str = "PARENT",
    *,
    is_hidden: bool = False,
) -> FamilyGroup | None:
    """
    Create a new family for a user with proper error handling.
    Returns the created family or None if creation fails.

    Args:
        user: The user to create a family for
        request: Optional request object for messages
        role: The role to assign to the user (default: "PARENT")
    """
    try:
        user_last_name = user.last_name or user.username
        if not user_last_name:
            logger.error(
                f"Cannot create family for user {user.id}: no last name or username"
            )
            return None

        with transaction.atomic():
            family_name = f"{user_last_name} Family"
            family = FamilyGroup.objects.create(
                name=family_name,
                is_hidden=is_hidden,
            )
            FamilyGroupType.objects.update_or_create(
                family=family, defaults={"type": "IMMEDIATE"}
            )
            # Use the provided role, default to PARENT for backward compatibility
            # Only set is_admin=True if the role is PARENT
            FamilyMembership.objects.create(
                user=user, family=family, role=role, is_admin=(role == "PARENT")
            )
            success, error = assign_primary_family(user, family, transaction_safe=False)
            if not success:
                logger.error(f"Failed to assign primary family: {error}")
                raise Exception(error)

            if request:
                messages.success(
                    request,
                    f'A new family group "{family_name}" has been created for you!',
                )

            logger.info(f"Created family '{family_name}' for user {user.id}")
            return family

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to create family for user {user.id}: {str(e)}")
        if request:
            messages.error(
                request,
                "There was an error creating your family group. Please contact support.",
            )
        return None


def _ensure_signup_family(
    user: User, request: HttpRequest | None = None
) -> FamilyGroup | None:
    if user.family_memberships.exists() or user.profile.primary_family:
        return user.profile.primary_family

    created_family = create_family_for_user(user, request)
    if not created_family:
        logger.warning("Failed to create fallback family for user %s", user.id)
    return created_family


def connect_family_to_meta(
    user: User, meta_family: FamilyGroup, request: HttpRequest | None = None
) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """
    Connect a user's existing family to a META family network.
    If the user doesn't have a family yet, create one first.

    Returns: (success: bool, message: str)
    """
    from .models import FamilyGroupType, MetaFamilyMembership

    try:
        # Check if the meta_family is actually a META type
        meta_type = FamilyGroupType.objects.filter(
            family=meta_family, type="META"
        ).first()
        if not meta_type:
            error_msg = f"{meta_family.name} is not a META family network"
            logger.error(error_msg)
            return False, error_msg

        # Get or create the user's immediate family
        user_family = None

        # First check if user has a primary family
        if hasattr(user, "profile") and user.profile.primary_family:
            user_family = user.profile.primary_family
            logger.info(
                f"Using existing primary family {user_family.name} for user {user.id}"
            )
        else:
            # Check if user has any family memberships
            membership = FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
                user=user, family__group_type__type="IMMEDIATE"
            ).first()

            if membership:
                user_family = membership.family
                logger.info(
                    f"Found existing immediate family {user_family.name} for user {user.id}"
                )

                # Set as primary if not already set
                if not user.profile.primary_family:
                    user.profile.primary_family = user_family
                    user.profile.save()
            else:
                # User doesn't have a family yet - create one
                logger.info(
                    f"Creating new family for user {user.id} to connect to META family"
                )
                user_family = create_family_for_user(user, request)
                if not user_family:
                    return False, "Failed to create family for user"

        # Check if already connected
        existing_connection = MetaFamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            family=user_family, meta_family=meta_family
        ).exists()

        if existing_connection:
            return True, f"Your family is already connected to {meta_family.name}"

        # Create the connection
        with transaction.atomic():
            MetaFamilyMembership.objects.create(
                family=user_family, meta_family=meta_family
            )
            logger.info(
                f"Connected family {user_family.name} to META family {meta_family.name}"
            )

        if request:
            messages.success(
                request,
                f"Your family has been connected to the {meta_family.name} network.",
            )

        return True, f"Successfully connected to {meta_family.name}"

    except Exception as e:
        error_msg = f"Failed to connect family to META family: {str(e)}"
        logger.error(error_msg)
        if request:
            messages.error(
                request,
                "An error occurred while connecting to the family network. Please contact support.",
            )
        return False, error_msg


class CustomAccountAdapter(DefaultAccountAdapter):
    """
    Custom account adapter to handle referral codes during signup
    """

    def get_signup_redirect_url(self, request):
        """
        Return the redirect URL after signup, checking for regional discovery users.
        """
        destination_url = super().get_signup_redirect_url(request)
        if request.user.is_authenticated:
            destination_url = (
                _get_safe_next_url(request)
                or _get_trip_invite_redirect_url(request)
                or _get_regional_discovery_redirect_url(request.user)
                or _get_captain_redirect_url(request.user)
                or destination_url
            )

        if is_app_install_handoff_enabled():
            return build_app_install_handoff_url(destination_url)
        return destination_url

    def get_reset_password_from_key_url(self, key):
        mobile_deep_link_base = _normalize_mobile_deep_link_base(
            getattr(self.request, "_mobile_reset_deep_link_base", None)
        )
        if mobile_deep_link_base:
            return f"{mobile_deep_link_base}/{quote(key, safe='')}"
        return super().get_reset_password_from_key_url(key)

    def save_user(self, request, user, form, commit=True):
        """
        Save the user and handle any referral code, family invite, or trip invite in the session
        """
        user = super().save_user(request, user, form, commit)
        # Check for family invite code first (highest priority)
        invite_code = request.session.get("family_invite_code")
        if invite_code and commit:
            try:
                # Use select_for_update to prevent race conditions
                invite = FamilyInvite.objects.select_for_update().get(
                    invite_code=invite_code,
                    email__iexact=user.email,
                    status="PENDING",
                )

                # Process the invite based on invitation context
                with transaction.atomic():
                    # Use invitation_context for consistent handling across the codebase
                    # Fallback to family type check for backward compatibility with old invites
                    if not invite.invitation_context:
                        # For backward compatibility, determine based on family type
                        family_type = FamilyGroupType.objects.filter(
                            family=invite.family
                        ).first()
                        if family_type:
                            invite.invitation_context = (
                                "IMMEDIATE"
                                if family_type.type == "IMMEDIATE"
                                else "META_JOIN"
                            )
                        else:
                            invite.invitation_context = (
                                "IMMEDIATE"  # Default to IMMEDIATE
                            )

                    if invite.invitation_context == "IMMEDIATE":
                        # Check if membership already exists (prevent duplicates)
                        membership_exists = FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
                            user=user, family=invite.family
                        ).exists()

                        if not membership_exists:
                            # Join directly with the role specified in the invitation
                            FamilyMembership.objects.create(
                                user=user,
                                family=invite.family,
                                role=invite.role,  # Use the invitation role
                                is_admin=False,
                            )
                        if not user.profile.primary_family:
                            user.profile.primary_family = invite.family
                            user.profile.save()

                    elif invite.invitation_context in ["META_CREATE", "META_JOIN"]:
                        # For META invitations, ensure user has a family first
                        # If they don't, create one with their invited role
                        if (
                            not hasattr(user, "profile")
                            or not user.profile.primary_family
                        ):
                            # Create a family for the user with their invited role
                            new_family = create_family_for_user(
                                user, request, role=invite.role
                            )
                            if not new_family:
                                logger.error(
                                    f"Failed to create family for user {user.id} during META invite acceptance"
                                )

                        # Handle based on specific META context
                        if (
                            invite.invitation_context == "META_JOIN"
                            and invite.existing_meta_group
                        ):
                            # Connect to existing META group
                            success, message = connect_family_to_meta(
                                user, invite.existing_meta_group, request
                            )
                        else:
                            # Connect to invite.family for META_CREATE or legacy META invites
                            success, message = connect_family_to_meta(
                                user, invite.family, request
                            )

                        if not success:
                            logger.error(
                                f"Failed to connect user {user.id} to META family during signup: {message}"
                            )

                    # Mark invite as accepted
                    invite.status = "ACCEPTED"
                    invite.save()

                    # Clear session
                    del request.session["family_invite_code"]

                    messages.success(
                        request, f"Welcome! You've been added to {invite.family.name}"
                    )

            except FamilyInvite.DoesNotExist:
                pass  # Invalid or expired invite

        # Check if there's a trip invite token in the session
        elif request.session.get("trip_invite_token"):
            # Store it for later processing after the user is fully set up
            # We'll handle this in get_login_redirect_url
            # But ensure user has at least one family for the invite flow
            if not user.family_memberships.exists():
                family = create_family_for_user(user, request)
                if family and request:
                    messages.info(
                        request,
                        f'A new family group "{family.name}" has been created for you. You can now accept the trip invitation.',
                    )

        # Check if there's a referral code in the session
        elif request.session.get("referral_code"):
            referral_code = request.session.get("referral_code")
            try:
                # Find the family by referral code
                family = FamilyGroup.objects.get(referral_code=referral_code)

                # Check if user is already a member of this family
                existing_membership = FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
                    user=user, family=family
                ).exists()

                if not existing_membership:
                    group_type = get_group_type(family)
                    if group_type == "META":
                        _ensure_signup_family(user, request)
                    result = submit_family_join_request(user=user, family=family)
                    approver_label = (
                        "network admin" if group_type == "META" else "family admin"
                    )
                    if result.already_pending:
                        messages.warning(
                            request,
                            f"You already have a pending request to join {family.name}.",
                        )
                    else:
                        messages.success(
                            request,
                            f"Your request to join {family.name} has been submitted. "
                            f"A {approver_label} will need to approve your request.",
                        )
                    _ensure_signup_family(user, request)
                # Remove the referral code from the session only if it was processed successfully
                if "referral_code" in request.session:
                    del request.session["referral_code"]

            except FamilyGroup.DoesNotExist:
                # Invalid referral code, just ignore
                pass

        # Migrate regional discovery data from session to user account
        if commit:
            try:
                _migrate_regional_discovery(request, user)
            except Exception as e:
                # Don't fail signup if migration fails
                logger.error(
                    "Failed to migrate regional discovery for user %s: %s",
                    user.id,
                    str(e),
                )

        return user

    def get_login_redirect_url(self, request):
        """
        Return the login redirect URL, checking for various redirect scenarios
        """
        # First, respect the ?next= parameter for any pending redirects
        # This is crucial for network invitations and other flows that require login
        next_url = _get_safe_next_url(request)
        if next_url:
            return next_url

        # Check if there's a trip invite token in the session
        trip_invite_url = _get_trip_invite_redirect_url(request)
        if trip_invite_url:
            # Redirect back to the invite acceptance URL
            return trip_invite_url

        # Check if user is a regional discovery user and should go to onboarding
        if request.user.is_authenticated:
            regional_url = _get_regional_discovery_redirect_url(request.user)
            if regional_url:
                return regional_url

        # Check if user is a charter captain
        captain_url = _get_captain_redirect_url(request.user)
        if captain_url:
            return captain_url

        # Otherwise use the default behavior
        return super().get_login_redirect_url(request)


class CustomSocialAccountAdapter(DefaultSocialAccountAdapter):
    """
    Custom social account adapter to handle referral codes during social signup,
    generate usernames from first and last names, and handle account merging
    """

    def populate_user(self, request, sociallogin, data):
        """
        Hook that can be used to further populate the user instance.
        """
        user = super().populate_user(request, sociallogin, data)

        # Get first and last name from social account data
        first_name = user.first_name or ""
        last_name = user.last_name or ""

        # If we have first and last name, generate a username
        if first_name and last_name:
            # Use the same username generation logic from CustomSignupForm
            form = CustomSignupForm()
            username = form.generate_unique_username(first_name, last_name)
            user.username = username

        # Store the first and last name in the sociallogin.state for later use
        # This ensures we have this data available when creating a family
        if first_name:
            sociallogin.state["first_name"] = first_name
        if last_name:
            sociallogin.state["last_name"] = last_name

        return user

    def pre_social_login(self, request, sociallogin):
        """
        Invoked just after a user successfully authenticates via a social provider,
        but before the login is actually processed.
        """
        # Check if this is a new social account
        if not sociallogin.is_existing:
            # Get the email from the social account
            email = sociallogin.account.extra_data.get("email")

            # If we have an email, check if a user with this email already exists
            if email:
                try:
                    # Look for existing user with this email
                    existing_user = User.objects.get(email__iexact=email)

                    # If we found a user, we need to handle this case
                    if existing_user:
                        # Get the provider name
                        provider_name = sociallogin.account.get_provider().name

                        # Set a message explaining the situation
                        messages.error(
                            request,
                            f"An account with email {email} already exists. Please sign in with your password and then "
                            f"connect your {provider_name} account from your profile settings.",
                        )

                        # Redirect to login page with email prefilled
                        login_url = reverse("account_login") + f"?login={email}"
                        raise ImmediateHttpResponse(redirect(login_url))

                except User.DoesNotExist:
                    # No existing user with this email, proceed with normal flow
                    pass

            # Process referral codes and join keys
            # Check for join_key in the request GET parameters (from social auth URL)
            join_key = request.GET.get("join_key")
            if join_key:
                # Store the join key in the sociallogin state
                sociallogin.state["family_join_key"] = join_key
                # Also store in session for backup
                request.session["family_join_key"] = join_key

            # Check if there's a referral code in the session
            referral_code = request.session.get("referral_code")
            if referral_code:
                # Store the referral code in the sociallogin object to use later
                sociallogin.state["referral_code"] = referral_code

            # Store family join key if it's in the session (for OAuth flow)
            family_join_key = request.session.get("family_join_key")
            if (
                family_join_key and not join_key
            ):  # Only if not already set from GET parameter
                sociallogin.state["family_join_key"] = family_join_key

        """
        Save the user and handle any referral code, family invite, or family join key
        """
        user = super().save_user(request, sociallogin, form)

class FamilyMembership(models.Model):
    """
    Represents a user's membership in a family group with a specific role
    """

    ROLE_CHOICES = [
        ("PARENT", "Parent"),
        ("GRANDPARENT", "Grandparent"),
        ("CHILD", "Child"),
        ("CAPTAIN", "Captain"),
        ("ORGANIZER", "Organizer"),
        ("MEMBER", "Member"),
        ("OTHER", "Other"),
    ]

    # DEPRECATED: This field is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.
    # Family relationships should be established using FamilyRelationship and FamilyGroupType models.
    FAMILY_TYPE_CHOICES = [
        ("IMMEDIATE", "Immediate Family"),
        ("EXTENDED", "Extended Family"),
        ("OTHER", "Other"),
    ]

    user = models.ForeignKey(
        User, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="family_memberships"
    )
    family = models.ForeignKey(
        FamilyGroup, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="memberships"
    )
    role = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=ROLE_CHOICES)
    # DEPRECATED: This field is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.
    # Family relationships should be established using FamilyRelationship and FamilyGroupType models.
    family_type = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=FAMILY_TYPE_CHOICES, default="EXTENDED"
    )
    is_admin = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(
        default=True,
        help_text="Indicates whether the membership is currently active.",
    )
    joined_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        unique_together = ("user", "family")

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.user.username} - {self.family.name} ({self.role})"

        family_groups: list[FamilyGroup],

        region: TripRegion | None = None,
        date_status: str = Trip.DateStatus.EXACT,
    ) -> Trip:
        """
        Create a new trip.

        Args:
            name: The name of the trip
            start_date: The start date of the trip
            end_date: The end date of the trip
            location: The location of the trip
            description: The description of the trip
            creator: The User who is creating the trip
            family_groups: A list of FamilyGroup instances to include in the trip
            gamification_enabled: Whether gamification is enabled for this trip
            region: The TripRegion instance for this trip (optional)
            date_status: Whether the trip has exact dates or is still being planned

        Returns:
            Trip: The created trip
        """
        from calendars.models import InternalCalendar
        from trips.models import TripMember
        from trips.services.notification_service import TripNotificationService
        from trips.services.participation_resolver import TripParticipationResolver

        TripService._validate_date_state(
            date_status=date_status,
            start_date=start_date,
            end_date=end_date,
        )

        # Create an internal calendar for the trip
        calendar = InternalCalendar.objects.create(
            name=f"Trip: {name}",
            user=creator,
            type="VACATION",
            color="#FF9500",  # Orange color for trip calendars
        )

        # Create the trip
        trip = Trip.objects.create(
            name=name,
            date_status=date_status,
            start_date=start_date,
            end_date=end_date,
            location=location,
            description=description,
            creator=creator,
            internal_calendar=calendar,
            gamification_enabled=gamification_enabled,
            region=region,  # Assign the passed region here
        )

        # Add the accepted household participation rows.
        TripParticipationResolver().add_creator_families(
            trip,
            _dedupe_families(family_groups, creator),
            creator,
        )

        # Add the creator as a member
        TripMember.objects.create(
            trip=trip,
            user=creator,
            arrival_date=start_date,
            departure_date=end_date,
        )

        # Check if trip notifications are enabled
        notifications_enabled = feature_client.get_boolean_value(
            "enable-trip-notifications", False
        )

            logger.info(f"Sending trip creation notification for trip {trip.id}")
            TripNotificationService.notify_trip_created(trip, creator)

            logger.info(
                f"Trip creation notifications disabled, skipping for trip {trip.id}"
            )

def _format_special_time(target_datetime: datetime) -> str:
    """Render a compact local time label without relying on platform-specific flags."""

    return (
        target_datetime.astimezone(timezone.get_current_timezone())
        .strftime("%I:%M %p")
        .lstrip("0")
    )


def _build_trip_special_days(trip: Trip) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Group FOOD occurrences for the full trip window so they can render outside the grid."""

    if trip.region is None or not trip.has_exact_dates:
        return []

    trip_start_date = trip.start_date
    trip_end_date = trip.end_date
    if trip_start_date is None or trip_end_date is None:
        return []

    effective_start = max(trip_start_date, timezone.localdate())

    special_events = list(
        filter_events_with_occurrences_in_range(
            RegionEvent.objects.filter(
                region_calendar__region=trip.region,
                is_active=True,
                category="FOOD",
            ).select_related("region_calendar__region", "regional_area"),
            start_date=effective_start,
            end_date=trip_end_date,
        )
    )
    if not special_events:
        return []

    events_by_id = {event.id: event for event in special_events}
    meal_period_labels = dict(RegionEvent.MEAL_PERIOD_CHOICES)
    special_days: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    current_date: date | None = None
    current_bucket: dict[str, Any] | None = None

    for occurrence in build_occurrence_rows(
        special_events,
        start_date=effective_start,
        end_date=trip_end_date,
    ):
        occurrence_date = occurrence["occurrence_date"]
        if current_bucket is None or current_date != occurrence_date:
            current_date = occurrence_date
            current_bucket = {
                "date": occurrence_date,
                "label": f"{occurrence_date.strftime('%A, %b')} {occurrence_date.day}",
                "occurrences": [],
            }
            special_days.append(current_bucket)

        special_event = events_by_id[occurrence["event_id"]]
        start_label = _format_special_time(occurrence["start_datetime"])
        end_label = _format_special_time(occurrence["end_datetime"])
        meal_period_key = occurrence.get("meal_period") or ""
        current_bucket["occurrences"].append(
            {
                **occurrence,
                "meal_period_label": meal_period_labels.get(meal_period_key, ""),
                "time_label": f"{start_label} - {end_label}",
                "url": special_event.get_occurrence_url(occurrence_date),
            }
        )

    return special_days


def _build_display_events_by_day(
    events_by_day: dict[int, list[Event]],
    *,
    trip: Trip | None,
    show_regional: bool,
) -> tuple[dict[int, list[Event]], dict[int, int]]:
    """Reduce calendar-cell crowding by limiting how many regional items land in the grid."""

    display_events_by_day: dict[int, list[Event]] = {}
    overflow_count_by_day: dict[int, int] = {}

    for day, day_events in events_by_day.items():
        if not trip or not show_regional:
            visible_events = day_events[:4]
        else:
            primary_events = [
                event for event in day_events if not event.is_regional_event_mirror
            ]
            regional_events = [
                event for event in day_events if event.is_regional_event_mirror
            ]

            visible_events = primary_events[:3]
            regional_limit = 1 if primary_events else 2
            remaining_slots = max(0, 4 - len(visible_events))
            visible_events.extend(
                regional_events[: min(remaining_slots, regional_limit)]
            )
            visible_events = sorted(
                visible_events,
                key=lambda event: (
                    event.start_time,
                    event.title.lower(),
                    str(event.id),
                ),
            )[:4]

        display_events_by_day[day] = visible_events
        overflow_count_by_day[day] = max(0, len(day_events) - len(visible_events))

    return display_events_by_day, overflow_count_by_day


def _get_visible_events(request, year, month, filter_params):
    """
    Helper function to fetch events visible to the user for a given month,
    applying filters and base visibility rules.
    Includes preliminary logic for ExternalAccountVisibility checks.
    """
    user = request.user
    if not user.is_authenticated:
        return Event.objects.none()

    # Get user's active family memberships and roles
    user_memberships = FamilyMembership.objects.filter(user=user, is_active=True)
    user_family_ids = list(user_memberships.values_list("family_id", flat=True))
    user_roles_in_families = {
        m.family_id: m.role for m in user_memberships
    }  # {family_uuid: role_str}

    # Get all meta family groups the user's families are members of
    meta_family_ids = list(
        MetaFamilyMembership.objects.filter(family_id__in=user_family_ids).values_list(
            "meta_family_id", flat=True
        )
    )

    # Get all families that are members of these meta family groups (the family network)
    network_family_ids = list(
        MetaFamilyMembership.objects.filter(meta_family_id__in=meta_family_ids)
        .values_list("family_id", flat=True)
        .distinct()
    )
    all_accessible_family_ids = list(set(user_family_ids + network_family_ids))

    # Get start and end dates for the month
    first_day = datetime(year, month, 1, tzinfo=timezone.get_current_timezone())
    if month == 12:
        # Be careful with timezone for the end date calculation
        last_day = datetime(
            year + 1, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.get_current_timezone()
        ) - timedelta(days=1)
    else:
        last_day = datetime(
            year, month + 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.get_current_timezone()
        ) - timedelta(days=1)
    month_end_datetime = last_day.replace(
        hour=23, minute=59, second=59, microsecond=999999
    )

    # Get user's calendars (needed for filtering if no specific calendars selected)
    internal_calendars = InternalCalendar.objects.filter(
        Q(user=user) | Q(associated_users=user),
        is_active=True,
    ).distinct()
    external_calendars = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.filter(
        user=user, is_active=True, sync_enabled=True
    )

    # Get all available internal calendar IDs for the user
    all_internal_cal_ids = list(internal_calendars.values_list("id", flat=True))
    # Get all external calendar identifiers used by external Event.calendar_id values.
    all_external_cal_account_ids = [
        str(cal_id) for cal_id in external_calendars.values_list("id", flat=True)
    ]
    all_external_provider_calendar_ids = list(
        external_calendars.exclude(calendar_id="").values_list("calendar_id", flat=True)
    )

    # Process filter parameters from the request or defaults
    selected_internal_calendars_str = filter_params.get("internal_calendars", "").split(
        ","
    )
    selected_external_calendars_str = filter_params.get("external_calendars", "").split(
        ","
    )
    selected_families_str = filter_params.get("families", "").split(",")
    selected_visibilities_str = filter_params.get("visibilities", "").split(",")
    selected_members_str = filter_params.get("members", "").split(",")

    selected_internal_calendars = [
        uuid.UUID(cal_id) for cal_id in selected_internal_calendars_str if cal_id
    ]
    selected_external_calendars = [
        int(cal_id) for cal_id in selected_external_calendars_str if cal_id.isdigit()
    ]
    selected_families = [
        uuid.UUID(fam_id) for fam_id in selected_families_str if fam_id
    ]
    selected_visibilities = [
        v for v in selected_visibilities_str if v in ["PUBLIC", "PRIVATE", "PERSONAL"]
    ]
    selected_members = [
        int(mem_id) for mem_id in selected_members_str if mem_id.isdigit()
    ]

    # --- Build the base query ---
    # Initial filter for the month range
    base_events_query = Q(
        # Events starting within the month
        Q(start_time__gte=first_day, start_time__lte=month_end_datetime)
        |
        # Events ending within the month
        Q(end_time__gte=first_day, end_time__lte=month_end_datetime)
        |
        # Events spanning the entire month
        Q(start_time__lt=first_day, end_time__gt=month_end_datetime)
    )

    # --- Calendar Filtering ---
    calendar_filter = Q()
    has_calendar_filter = bool(
        selected_internal_calendars or selected_external_calendars
    )

    if selected_internal_calendars:
        calendar_filter |= Q(internal_calendar_id__in=selected_internal_calendars)

    if selected_external_calendars:
        selected_external_calendar_values: list[str] = []
        selected_external_accounts = external_calendars.filter(
            id__in=selected_external_calendars
        )
        for selected_account in selected_external_accounts:
            selected_external_calendar_values.append(str(selected_account.id))
            if selected_account.calendar_id:
                selected_external_calendar_values.append(selected_account.calendar_id)

        selected_external_calendar_values = list(
            dict.fromkeys(selected_external_calendar_values)
        )

        calendar_filter |= Q(
            is_external=True, calendar_id__in=selected_external_calendar_values
        )

    if not has_calendar_filter:
        # If no specific calendars selected, include all user's active internal and external
        all_external_calendar_values = list(
            dict.fromkeys(
                all_external_cal_account_ids + all_external_provider_calendar_ids
            )
        )
        calendar_filter |= Q(internal_calendar_id__in=all_internal_cal_ids)
        calendar_filter |= Q(
            is_external=True, calendar_id__in=all_external_calendar_values
        )
        # Also include PUBLIC events from accessible families (including network/meta-family events)
        calendar_filter |= Q(
            visibility="PUBLIC",
            family_group_id__in=all_accessible_family_ids,
        )
        # Include events where user is a participant (regardless of calendar assignment)
        calendar_filter |= Q(participants__user=user)
        # Include events created by the user (regardless of calendar assignment)
        calendar_filter |= Q(creator=user)

    base_events_query &= calendar_filter

    # --- Family Filtering ---
    # Apply family filter only if specific families are selected
    if selected_families:
        base_events_query &= Q(family_group_id__in=selected_families)
    # Note: If no families selected, we don't filter by family here; visibility rules handle access

    # --- Member Filtering ---
    # Apply member filter only if specific members are selected
    if selected_members:
        base_events_query &= Q(participants__user_id__in=selected_members)
    # Note: If no members selected, visibility rules handle access

    # --- Initial Fetch (Pre-Visibility Check) ---
    # Fetch events matching date, calendar, family (if selected), member (if selected)
    potential_events = (
        Event.objects.filter(base_events_query)
        .distinct()
        .select_related(
            "creator",
            "creator__profile",
            "family_group",
            "internal_calendar",  # Add external_calendar? No, use calendar_id
        )
        .prefetch_related(
            "participants",
        )
    )

    # Prefetch external calendar accounts and visibility rules to avoid N+1 queries
    external_event_calendar_sources = {
        str(event.calendar_id)
        for event in potential_events
        if event.is_external and event.calendar_id
    }
    external_event_calendar_account_ids = [
        int(source) for source in external_event_calendar_sources if source.isdigit()
    ]

    # Batch fetch external calendar accounts by either account PK or provider calendar_id.
    external_accounts_map: dict[str, ExternalCalendarAccount] = {}
    external_account_ids_for_rules: set[int] = set()
    if external_event_calendar_sources:
        external_accounts_query = Q(calendar_id__in=external_event_calendar_sources)
        if external_event_calendar_account_ids:
            external_accounts_query |= Q(id__in=external_event_calendar_account_ids)

        for external_account in ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.filter(
            external_accounts_query
        ).select_related("user__profile"):
            external_accounts_map[str(external_account.id)] = external_account
            if external_account.calendar_id:
                external_accounts_map[str(external_account.calendar_id)] = (
                    external_account
                )
            external_account_ids_for_rules.add(external_account.id)

    # Batch fetch visibility rules for all resolved external accounts.
    visibility_rules_map: dict[str, list[ExternalAccountVisibility]] = {}
    if external_account_ids_for_rules:
        for rule in ExternalAccountVisibility.objects.filter(
            external_account_id__in=external_account_ids_for_rules
        ).select_related("shared_with_user"):
            rule_key = str(rule.external_account_id)
            if rule_key not in visibility_rules_map:
                visibility_rules_map[rule_key] = []
            visibility_rules_map[rule_key].append(rule)

    # Pre-compute the viewer's role in each external account owner's family.
    # This avoids repeating the lookup for every event in the per-event loop.
    owner_family_role_map: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    for acct in external_accounts_map.values():
        acct_key = str(acct.id)
        if acct_key in owner_family_role_map:
            continue
        owner_profile = getattr(acct.user, "profile", None)
        owner_family_id = (
            getattr(owner_profile, "primary_family_id", None) if owner_profile else None
        )
        if not owner_family_id:
            immediate = get_user_immediate_family(acct.user)
            owner_family_id = immediate.id if immediate else None
        owner_family_role_map[acct_key] = (
            user_roles_in_families.get(owner_family_id) if owner_family_id else None
        )

    # Pre-fetch shared tentative event IDs to avoid N+1 in the per-event loop
    shared_tentative_event_ids: set[uuid.UUID] = set(
        TentativeEventShare.objects.filter(
            target_family_id__in=user_family_ids,
        ).values_list("event_id", flat=True)
    )

    # --- Visibility Filtering (Post-Fetch) ---
    visible_event_ids = set()

    for event in potential_events:
        can_view = False

        # 1. Creator always sees their own event
        if event.creator == user:
            can_view = True

        # 2. Participants always see events they are part of
        elif any(
            participant.user_id == user.id for participant in event.participants.all()
        ):
            can_view = True

        # 3. Check internal event visibility (Non-external events)
        elif not event.is_external:
            if (
                event.internal_calendar_id
                and event.internal_calendar_id in all_internal_cal_ids
            ):
                can_view = True
            # Check if it's a PUBLIC event within an accessible family
            elif (
                event.visibility == "PUBLIC"
                and event.family_group_id in all_accessible_family_ids
            ):
                can_view = True
            # Check if it's a PERSONAL event created by the user (already covered by #1)
            # Check if it's a PRIVATE event (only creator/participants see - covered by #1 and #2)
            # TODO: Add checks for InternalCalendarVisibility model if implemented

        # 4. Check external event visibility (External events)
        elif (
            event.is_external and event.calendar_id
        ):  # calendar_id is the PK of ExternalCalendarAccount
            # Use prefetched data instead of querying database
            account = external_accounts_map.get(str(event.calendar_id))
            if account:
                account_owner = account.user

                # Owner always sees their own external events
                if user == account_owner:
                    can_view = True
                else:
                    viewer_role_in_owner_family = owner_family_role_map.get(
                        str(account.id)
                    )

                    # Check ExternalAccountVisibility rules defined for this account
                    rules = visibility_rules_map.get(str(account.id), [])

                    for rule in rules:
                        # Check rule by specific user
                        if rule.shared_with_user_id == user.id:
                            # TODO: Check permission_level if more granular control is added
                            can_view = True
                            break  # Corrected indentation
                        # Check role in the account owner's primary family only
                        if rule.shared_with_role:
                            if viewer_role_in_owner_family == rule.shared_with_role:
                                # TODO: Check permission_level if more granular control is added
                                can_view = True
                                break

        # 5. Check if event is a shared tentative event for user's families
        if not can_view and event.event_status == "TENTATIVE":
            if event.id in shared_tentative_event_ids:
                can_view = True

        # 6. Apply manual visibility type filter ('PUBLIC', 'PRIVATE', 'PERSONAL') if provided
        # This acts as an additional filter *after* basic access is granted.
        # Note: 'PRIVATE'/'PERSONAL' might be redundant if creator/participant checks already passed.
        # 'PUBLIC' check might be redundant if family access granted it. Re-evaluate if this filter is needed.
        if can_view and selected_visibilities:
            if event.visibility not in selected_visibilities:
                can_view = (
                    False  # Override access if visibility type doesn't match filter
                )

        if can_view:
            visible_event_ids.add(event.id)

    # --- Final Query ---
    # Fetch the final set of visible events by ID
    visible_events = (
        Event.objects.filter(id__in=visible_event_ids)
        .order_by("start_time")
        .select_related(
            "creator", "creator__profile", "family_group", "internal_calendar"
        )
        .prefetch_related("participants")
    )

    return visible_events


@login_required
def calendar_view(request):
    """
    Main calendar view showing events in a monthly calendar format with advanced filtering
    """
    # Check if we're viewing a specific calendar (e.g. from a trip)
    calendar_id_str = request.GET.get("calendar_id")
    trip = None
    regional_calendar_id = None  # ID of the calendar holding regional events
    show_regional = True

    if calendar_id_str:
        try:
            calendar_id = uuid.UUID(calendar_id_str)  # Convert to UUID
            # Use select_related to fetch region efficiently
            trip = Trip.objects.select_related("region", "internal_calendar").get(
                internal_calendar_id=calendar_id
            )
            if trip.region:
                try:
                    # Find the RegionCalendar linked to the trip's region
                    region_calendar = RegionCalendar.objects.select_related(
                        "internal_calendar"
                    ).get(region=trip.region)
                    regional_calendar_id = region_calendar.internal_calendar.id  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                except RegionCalendar.DoesNotExist:
                    pass  # No specific calendar defined for this region
        except (Trip.DoesNotExist, ValueError, DjangoValidationError):
            pass  # Invalid calendar_id or not a trip calendar

    if trip:
        show_regional_value = request.GET.get("show_regional")
        if show_regional_value is not None:
            show_regional = show_regional_value.lower() not in {"0", "false", "off"}

    # Get the current date or the requested date
    year_str = request.GET.get("year")
    month_str = request.GET.get("month")

    if trip and trip.has_exact_dates and not year_str and not month_str:
        # Default to trip start date if viewing trip and no date specified
        trip_start_date = trip.start_date
        if trip_start_date is not None:
            year = trip_start_date.year
            month = trip_start_date.month
        else:
            year = timezone.now().year
            month = timezone.now().month
    else:
        # Otherwise, use query params or current date
        year = int(year_str) if year_str and year_str.isdigit() else timezone.now().year
        month = (
            int(month_str)
            if month_str and month_str.isdigit()
            else timezone.now().month
        )

    # Get current date and time for highlighting today
    now = timezone.now()

    # Create calendar for the specified month (week starts on Sunday)
    cal_module.setfirstweekday(cal_module.SUNDAY)
    cal_month = cal_module.monthcalendar(year, month)
    month_name = cal_module.month_name[month]

    # Calculate previous and next month/year for navigation links
    current_date = datetime(year, month, 1)
    prev_date = current_date - timedelta(days=1)
    next_date = (current_date + timedelta(days=32)).replace(day=1)
    prev_month, prev_year = prev_date.month, prev_date.year
    next_month, next_year = next_date.month, next_date.year

    # Prepare filter_params dictionary from request.GET for passing to helper and template
    filter_params = {k: v for k, v in request.GET.items() if k not in ["year", "month"]}

    # If viewing a trip, ensure its calendar is included in filters passed to helper
    if trip:
        current_internal_cals = filter_params.get("internal_calendars", "").split(",")
        current_internal_cals = [
            c for c in current_internal_cals if c
        ]  # Remove empty strings
        # Add trip calendar ID
        if str(trip.internal_calendar_id) not in current_internal_cals:
            current_internal_cals.append(str(trip.internal_calendar_id))
        # Add regional calendar ID if exists
        if regional_calendar_id:
            regional_calendar_id_str = str(regional_calendar_id)
            current_internal_cals = [
                cal_id
                for cal_id in current_internal_cals
                if cal_id != regional_calendar_id_str
            ]
            if show_regional:
                current_internal_cals.append(regional_calendar_id_str)
        filter_params["internal_calendars"] = ",".join(current_internal_cals)

    # Get events using the helper function
    with child_span("web.calendars.month.load_events") as load_span:
        events = list(_get_visible_events(request, year, month, filter_params))
        set_span_attributes(
            load_span,
            event_count=len(events),
            has_trip_context=bool(trip),
            internal_calendar_filter_count=len(
                [
                    cal_id
                    for cal_id in filter_params.get("internal_calendars", "").split(",")
                    if cal_id
                ]
            ),
            external_calendar_filter_count=len(
                [
                    cal_id
                    for cal_id in filter_params.get("external_calendars", "").split(",")
                    if cal_id.isdigit()
                ]
            ),
        )

    trip_special_days: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    if trip:
        if show_regional:
            trip_special_days = _build_trip_special_days(trip)
        trip_special_event_ids = {
            occurrence["event_id"]
            for day in trip_special_days
            for occurrence in day["occurrences"]
        }
        if trip_special_event_ids:
            events = [
                event
                for event in events
                if not (
                    event.is_regional_event_mirror
                    and event.mirrored_region_event_id in trip_special_event_ids
                )
            ]
        elif not show_regional:
            events = [event for event in events if not event.is_regional_event_mirror]

    # --- Post-processing and Context Preparation ---

    # Get necessary data for filters in the template sidebar
    user_family_ids = list(
        request.user.family_memberships.values_list("family_id", flat=True)
    )
    family_groups = FamilyGroup.objects.filter(id__in=user_family_ids)
    family_members = (
        User.objects.filter(family_memberships__family_id__in=user_family_ids)
        .distinct()
        .exclude(id=request.user.id)
    )
    external_calendars = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.filter(user=request.user)
    internal_calendars = InternalCalendar.objects.filter(
        Q(user=request.user) | Q(associated_users=request.user),
        is_active=True,
    ).distinct()

    # Extract selected filter values from filter_params for template context
    selected_internal_calendars = [
        uuid.UUID(cal_id)  # Convert to UUID
        for cal_id in filter_params.get("internal_calendars", "").split(",")
        if cal_id  # Check for empty string
    ]
    selected_external_calendars = [
        int(cal_id)
        for cal_id in filter_params.get("external_calendars", "").split(",")
        if cal_id.isdigit()
    ]
    selected_families = [
        uuid.UUID(fam_id)  # Convert to UUID
        for fam_id in filter_params.get("families", "").split(",")
        if fam_id  # Check for empty string
    ]
    selected_visibilities = [
        v
        for v in filter_params.get("visibilities", "").split(",")
        if v in ["PUBLIC", "PRIVATE", "PERSONAL"]
    ]
    selected_members = [
        int(mem_id)
        for mem_id in filter_params.get("members", "").split(",")
        if mem_id.isdigit()
    ]

    # --- Fetch associated child info ---
    # This logic might need optimization if performance becomes an issue
    with child_span(
        "web.calendars.month.build_child_info",
        event_count=len(events),
    ) as child_info_span:
        child_info_by_calendar: dict[
            UUID | str | int, dict[str, str]
        ] = {}  # Maps calendar identifier (internal ID or external account PK) to child info

        # Process internal calendars associated with fetched events
        internal_calendar_ids_for_events = {
            e.internal_calendar_id for e in events if e.internal_calendar_id
        }
        if internal_calendar_ids_for_events:
            internal_calendars_with_children = InternalCalendar.objects.filter(
                id__in=internal_calendar_ids_for_events
            ).prefetch_related("associated_children")
            for cal in internal_calendars_with_children:
                for child in cal.associated_children.all():
                    if child.profile_picture:

class TripMemberForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """Form for creating and updating TripMember."""

    def __init__(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        """
        Initialize the form, accepting the trip to filter eligible users.
        """
        # Pop the trip parameter if it exists
        self.trip = kwargs.pop("trip", None)
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)

        if self.trip:
            # Get all users from families associated with the trip
            from django.contrib.auth.models import User

            from users.utils import get_families_member_ids

            # Get all family IDs associated with the trip
            family_ids = list(active_families(self.trip).values_list("id", flat=True))

            # Get all user IDs who are members of these families
            user_ids = get_families_member_ids(family_ids)

            # Filter the user field to only show users from trip's families
            user_field = self.fields["user"]
            user_field.queryset = User.objects.filter(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
                id__in=user_ids
            ).order_by("first_name", "last_name", "username")

            # Exclude users who are already members of the trip
            existing_member_ids = self.trip.members.values_list("user_id", flat=True)
            user_field.queryset = user_field.queryset.exclude(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
                id__in=existing_member_ids
            )

        model = TripMember
        fields = ["user", "arrival_date", "departure_date", "notes"]

class TripMemberForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """Form for creating and updating TripMember."""

    def __init__(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        """
        Initialize the form, accepting the trip to filter eligible users.
        """
        # Pop the trip parameter if it exists
        self.trip = kwargs.pop("trip", None)
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)

        if self.trip:
            # Get all users from families associated with the trip
            from django.contrib.auth.models import User

            from users.utils import get_families_member_ids

            # Get all family IDs associated with the trip
            family_ids = list(active_families(self.trip).values_list("id", flat=True))

            # Get all user IDs who are members of these families
            user_ids = get_families_member_ids(family_ids)

            # Filter the user field to only show users from trip's families
            user_field = self.fields["user"]
            user_field.queryset = User.objects.filter(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
                id__in=user_ids
            ).order_by("first_name", "last_name", "username")

            # Exclude users who are already members of the trip
            existing_member_ids = self.trip.members.values_list("user_id", flat=True)
            user_field.queryset = user_field.queryset.exclude(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
                id__in=existing_member_ids

        model = TripMember

class TripViewSet(FeatureRequiredMixin, viewsets.ModelViewSet[Trip]):
    """ViewSet for Trip model."""

    required_feature = "trips"
    serializer_class = TripSerializer
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get_queryset(self) -> QuerySet[Trip]:
        """
        Return trips that the user is a member of, annotated with photo_count.
        """
        user = cast(User, self.request.user)
        return (
            trip_queryset_for_user(user, Trip.objects.filter(deleted_at__isnull=True))
            .annotate(photo_count=Count("photos", distinct=True))
            .distinct()
        )  # type: ignore[misc]

    def get_serializer_class(self) -> type[BaseSerializer[Any]]:
        """
        Return appropriate serializer class based on the action.
        """
        if self.action in {"create", "update", "partial_update"}:
            return TripCreateSerializer
        return TripSerializer

    def _require_trip_creator(self, trip: Trip) -> None:
        user = cast(User, self.request.user)
        if trip.creator_id != user.id:
            raise PermissionDenied("Only the trip creator can modify or delete trips.")

    def _validate_family_groups_membership(
        self, family_groups: list[FamilyGroup] | None
    ) -> None:
        """Reject family_groups containing families the caller has no membership in.

        Without this check a malicious client could attach a Trip to any
        FamilyGroup by guessing the UUID — a mass-assignment IDOR (Lane 2 M).
        Empty / missing values are accepted so partial updates that don't
        touch ``family_groups`` continue to work.
        """
        if not family_groups:
            return
        user = cast(User, self.request.user)
        # Use is_active=True to mirror the rest of the codebase's family
        # access checks; deactivated members shouldn't be able to attach
        # new resources to families they no longer belong to.
        user_family_ids = set(
            user.family_memberships.filter(is_active=True).values_list(
                "family_id", flat=True
            )
        )
        bad = [fg for fg in family_groups if fg.id not in user_family_ids]
        if bad:
            raise PermissionDenied(
                "Cannot attach trip to families you are not a member of."
            )

    def create(self, request: Request, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Response:
        """
        Create a trip and return the detail serializer response.
        TripCreateSerializer is write-only; use TripSerializer for the response
        so the mobile client receives id, creator, created_at, etc.
        """
        serializer = self.get_serializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        self.perform_create(serializer)
        # Re-fetch with annotations (photo_count) and serialize with detail serializer
        instance = serializer.instance
        assert instance is not None  # set by perform_create
        trip = self.get_queryset().get(pk=instance.pk)
        response_serializer = TripSerializer(
            trip, context=self.get_serializer_context()
        )
        headers = self.get_success_headers(response_serializer.data)
        return Response(
            response_serializer.data, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, headers=headers
        )

    def update(self, request: Request, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Response:
        """
        Update a trip and return the detail serializer response.
        """
        partial = kwargs.pop("partial", False)
        instance = self.get_object()
        self._require_trip_creator(instance)
        serializer = self.get_serializer(instance, data=request.data, partial=partial)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        self.perform_update(serializer)
        # Re-fetch with annotations and serialize with detail serializer
        trip = self.get_queryset().get(pk=instance.pk)
        response_serializer = TripSerializer(
            trip, context=self.get_serializer_context()
        )
        return Response(response_serializer.data)

    def destroy(self, request: Request, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Response:
        instance = self.get_object()
        self._require_trip_creator(instance)
        return super().destroy(request, *args, **kwargs)

    def perform_create(self, serializer: BaseSerializer[Trip]) -> None:
        """
        Create a new trip.
        """
        try:
            with transaction.atomic():
                # Extract data from serializer
                name = serializer.validated_data["name"]
                date_status = serializer.validated_data.get(
                    "date_status", Trip.DateStatus.EXACT
                )
                start_date = serializer.validated_data.get("start_date")
                end_date = serializer.validated_data.get("end_date")
                location = serializer.validated_data["location"]
                description = serializer.validated_data.get("description", "")
                family_groups = serializer.validated_data["family_groups"]
                gamification_enabled = serializer.validated_data.get(
                    "gamification_enabled", True
                )
                region = serializer.validated_data.get("region", None)
                user = cast(User, self.request.user)
                self._validate_family_groups_membership(family_groups)

                # Create trip using service
                trip = TripService.create_trip(
                    name=name,
                    date_status=date_status,
                    start_date=start_date,
                    end_date=end_date,
                    location=location,
                    description=description,
                    creator=user,
                    family_groups=family_groups,
                    gamification_enabled=gamification_enabled,
                    region=region,
                )

                # Set the instance on serializer for response
                serializer.instance = trip

            record_wide_event(
                request=self.request,
                operation="trip.create",
                outcome="success",
            )

            from family_scheduler.tracking.client import (
                TrackingEventDetails,
                get_tracking_client,
            )

            get_tracking_client().track(
                "trip_created",
                distinct_id=str(user.id),
                details=TrackingEventDetails(
                    data={
                        "family_group_count": len(family_groups),
                    }
                ),
            )
        except ValidationError as e:
            logger.warning("Validation error creating trip: %s", str(e))
            raise
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error("Error creating trip: %s", str(e), exc_info=True)
            raise ValidationError(
                {"detail": "Failed to create trip. Please try again."}
            ) from None

    def perform_update(self, serializer: BaseSerializer[Trip]) -> None:
        """
        Update a trip.
        """
        # Get trip instance before try block to ensure it's always bound
        trip = cast(Trip, serializer.instance)
        try:
            with transaction.atomic():
                # Extract data from serializer
                name = serializer.validated_data.get("name")
                date_status = serializer.validated_data.get("date_status", UNSET)
                start_date = (
                    serializer.validated_data["start_date"]
                    if "start_date" in serializer.validated_data
                    else UNSET
                )
                end_date = (
                    serializer.validated_data["end_date"]
                    if "end_date" in serializer.validated_data
                    else UNSET
                )
                location = serializer.validated_data.get("location")
                description = serializer.validated_data.get("description")
                family_groups = serializer.validated_data.get("family_groups")
                gamification_enabled = serializer.validated_data.get(
                    "gamification_enabled"
                )
                region = (
                    serializer.validated_data["region"]
                    if "region" in serializer.validated_data
                    else UNSET
                )
                user = cast(User, self.request.user)
                self._validate_family_groups_membership(family_groups)

                # Update trip using service
                TripService.update_trip(
                    trip=trip,
                    name=name,
                    date_status=date_status,
                    start_date=start_date,
                    end_date=end_date,
                    location=location,
                    description=description,
                    updater=user,
                    family_groups=family_groups,
                    gamification_enabled=gamification_enabled,
                    region=region,
                )
            record_wide_event(
                request=self.request,
                operation="trip.update",
                outcome="success",
            )
        except ValidationError as e:
            logger.warning("Validation error updating trip %s: %s", trip.id, str(e))
            raise
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(
                "Error updating trip %s: %s",
                trip.id,
                str(e),
                exc_info=True,
            )
            raise ValidationError(
                {"detail": "Failed to update trip. Please try again."}

        """

        quest = request.data.get("quest")
        if not quest:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Quest is required."},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,

    @action(detail=True, methods=["get"], url_path="photos")
    def photos(self, request: Request, **kwargs: Any) -> Response:
        """Return aggregated photos from TripPhoto + EventMedia."""
        from events.media_services import MediaStorageService

        trip = self.get_object()

        # Check membership
        user = cast(User, request.user)
        if not user_has_active_trip_access(trip, user):
            raise PermissionDenied("You are not a member of this trip.")

        request_host = None
        try:
            request_host = request.get_host()
        except Exception:  # noqa: S110
            pass

        # Trip photos
        trip_photos = TripPhoto.objects.filter(trip=trip).select_related("uploaded_by")
        aggregated = []
        for p in trip_photos:
            aggregated.append(
                {
                    "id": str(p.id),
                    "source": "trip",
                    "event_title": None,
                    "uploaded_by_name": p.uploaded_by.get_full_name()
                    or p.uploaded_by.username,
                    "media_type": p.media_type,
                    "file_url": MediaStorageService.generate_presigned_url(
                        p.file_key, request_host=request_host
                    )
                    if p.file_key
                    else None,
                    "thumbnail_url": MediaStorageService.generate_presigned_url(
                        p.thumbnail_key, request_host=request_host
                    )
                    if p.thumbnail_key
                    else None,
                    "caption": p.caption,
                    "width": p.width,
                    "height": p.height,
                    "uploaded_at": p.uploaded_at,
                }
            )

        # Event media from internal calendar
        if trip.internal_calendar:
            from events.models import EventMedia

            event_media = (
                EventMedia.secure.for_user(user)
                .filter(
                    event__internal_calendar=trip.internal_calendar,
                    media_type__in=["PHOTO", "VIDEO"],
                )
                .select_related("event", "uploaded_by")
            )

            for em in event_media:
                aggregated.append(
                    {
                        "id": str(em.id),
                        "source": "event",
                        "event_title": em.event.title if em.event else None,
                        "uploaded_by_name": em.uploaded_by.get_full_name()
                        or em.uploaded_by.username,
                        "media_type": em.media_type,
                        "file_url": MediaStorageService.generate_presigned_url(
                            em.file_key, request_host=request_host
                        )
                        if em.file_key
                        else None,
                        "thumbnail_url": MediaStorageService.generate_presigned_url(
                            em.thumbnail_key, request_host=request_host
                        )
                        if em.thumbnail_key
                        else None,
                        "caption": em.caption,
                        "width": em.width,
                        "height": em.height,
                        "uploaded_at": em.uploaded_at,
                    }
                )

        # Sort by uploaded_at descending
        aggregated.sort(key=lambda x: cast(datetime, x["uploaded_at"]), reverse=True)

        # Paginate
        page = self.paginate_queryset(cast(Any, aggregated))
        if page is not None:
            serializer = AggregatedTripPhotoSerializer(page, many=True)
            return self.get_paginated_response(serializer.data)

        serializer = AggregatedTripPhotoSerializer(aggregated, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)
